name: Close Quarters
source:
Starscream accompanies Megatron on an alien trade negotiation after mistranslating the glyphs on the plus one invitation as "lieutenant", when it actually said "lover".

[From [url=https://useless19.itch.io/close-quarters]Itch.io[/url]]

A short story based on [url=https://archiveofourown.org/works/13963140]Close Quarters[/url], a Transformers fan-fiction written by [url=https://archiveofourown.org/users/Spoon888/pseuds/Spoon888]Spoon888[/url].
translation:
红蜘蛛将加一邀请函上的字形误译为“中尉”，而实际上是“情人”，随后红蜘蛛陪同威震天进行了一次外星贸易谈判。

[来自[url=https://useless19.itch.io/close-quarters]Itch.io[/url]]

基于 [url=https://archiveofourown.org/works/13963140]Close Quarters[/url] 的短篇故事，这是由 [url=https://archiveofourown.org/users/Spoon888/pseuds/Spoon888]Spoon888[/url] 撰写的变形金刚同人小说。
